strata.label: managerial leadership in
strata.definition: Argument 1 holds or formerly held a managerial or leadership office in organization 2.
strata.scope_notes: Head, president, chair, chief, executive, director and manager qualify. Founder, owner, generic employee or spokesperson alone do not. Historical offices qualify.

strata.label: defeated
strata.definition: Argument 1 defeated argument 2 in a sporting, electoral or other explicit contest.
strata.scope_notes: Historical wins qualify. Playing, facing, a period score or standings lead alone does not show a win. Preserve direction winner to loser.

strata.label: communicated to
strata.definition: Argument 1 addressed, contacted or sent a message to argument 2.
strata.scope_notes: Tell, ask, urge, warn, write, talk and message recipient paths establish directed communication. Accusing or describing another person without addressing them is not enough. Sending a person somewhere is not sending them a message.

strata.label: organizational subsidiary or unit of
strata.definition: Argument 1 is or was an organizational subsidiary, division, unit or owned organization of parent 2.
strata.scope_notes: Direction subsidiary to parent. Explicit ownership qualifies, including partial ownership. Mere employment, a geographic base or business interaction does not.

strata.label: president or manager of
strata.definition: Argument 1 holds or formerly held the office of president or manager of organization 2.
strata.scope_notes: The two dominant title families are president and manager, as in the prior evaluation. Generic executive, director, owner, coach or political leader alone does not establish either title.

strata.label: lawyer or attorney for
strata.definition: Argument 1 serves as a lawyer, attorney or legal counsel for organization or person 2, including employment at a law firm.
strata.scope_notes: The aggregate lawyer/attorney/counsel family is chosen from a mixed professional-role dictionary. A professor, analyst, economist or director without legal representation evidence does not qualify. A firm partner without a legal-role attachment is ambiguous.

strata.label: winner or champion of
strata.definition: Argument 1 won competition or award 2 or holds its championship.
strata.scope_notes: Historical wins and explicit award recipients qualify. Merely playing, reaching an event, winning an individual stage, or holding political office does not. Boxing title-body champion paths qualify under the same broad championship scope as earlier audits.

strata.label: managerial leadership in
strata.definition: Argument 1 holds or formerly held a leadership office in organization 2.
strata.scope_notes: Chairman and head dominate, with director, executive and president paraphrases. Founder/owner alone is insufficient. Explicit former office qualifies; nomination alone does not show office held.

strata.label: traveled or moved to
strata.definition: Argument 1 traveled, relocated, returned or was transported to destination 2.
strata.scope_notes: Direction toward the destination. Visits and historical movements qualify. Mere presence, residence, officeholding, or leaving/moving from the second argument alone does not. Unobserved modality is a corpus limitation.

strata.label: organization located or based in
strata.definition: Organization 1 is based in or has an office/site in geographic place 2.
strata.scope_notes: Firm/company-in, based-in, headquarters-in and geographic noun compounds qualify. Nationality adjective alone is ambiguous between ownership/origin and actual base. A sector, parent company or person is not a geographic place.

strata.label: political or organizational leader of
strata.definition: Argument 1 is or was a political/organizational leader of group, legislature or political body 2.
strata.scope_notes: Leader, head, chair and legislative leadership posts qualify. Mere candidacy, party membership or communicating to a body does not. Leadership in a legislature includes majority/minority leadership, not only heading the entire chamber.

strata.label: contributed writing to publication
strata.definition: Argument 1 wrote, reviewed or worked as a critic for publication 2.
strata.scope_notes: This highly mixed dictionary has several competing themes and no clean dominant predicate. After reading all 38 complete fact groups, choose the coherent write-in/critic-for/review-for family, also resolving say-in ambiguity toward publications where local evidence permits. Geographic residence/travel and lawyer-in-city are competing predicates. This labeling choice is a material uncertainty in the precision estimate. Mere being quoted in a publication does not establish authorship.

strata.label: owns
strata.definition: Argument 1 owns or previously owned company, organization or asset 2.
strata.scope_notes: Parent, owner, acquisition and explicit partial ownership qualify in parent-to-child direction. Being born in a place, employment, management alone, or a proposed/rejected acquisition does not.

strata.label: organization located or based in
strata.definition: Organization 1 is based in or has headquarters, offices or a campus in geographic place 2.
strata.scope_notes: Historical bases and explicit organizational sites qualify. People, award recipients, leadership offices and merely named-as paths are other predicates.

strata.label: has political leader or minister
strata.definition: Political body, party, country or legislature 1 has or had person 2 as a leader, minister or senior political officeholder.
strata.scope_notes: Direction body to leader, inverse of the dominant leader-of family. Legislature majority/minority leaders and whips qualify. Spokespeople, aides, visitors, merely cited officials elsewhere and the reverse direction do not.

strata.label: athlete played for team
strata.definition: Person 1 played as an athlete for sports team 2.
strata.scope_notes: Team player/center/wing/guard/scorer membership and scoring for the team qualify. Coaching alone, merely leading an opponent, communication and corporate interactions do not.

strata.label: organization located or based in
strata.definition: Organization 1 is based in or has a geographic office/site in place 2.
strata.scope_notes: Firm/company-in and based-in paths qualify. Nationality adjectives alone remain ambiguous between geographic base and ownership/origin. Individual professionals, agencies as employers and sectors are other predicates.

strata.label: coach of
strata.definition: Person 1 is or was a coach of sports team or program 2.
strata.scope_notes: Explicit coach titles and coaching verbs qualify, including historical or dismissed coaches. Playing, owning, managing without coaching evidence, and political leadership do not.

strata.label: analyst for

strata.scope_notes: Explicit analyst titles and following/tracking an industry for the employer qualify. Economist, strategist or specialist without analyst evidence may require role-scope review; president/director/professor/lawyer alone do not establish this role.
